videos.title: Selena Gomez: I Never Felt Safe Being Myself Until Benny
videos.description:
Selena Gomez has been called fake for years. So why does she let Benny Blanco see who she really is?

In this episode, Selena Gomez, Benny Blanco and Jay Shetty talk about how a guarded friendship turned into love in a single day. Selena explains why she never planned to open up again, and what she felt the first time she walked into Benny's house.

Benny shares the text he sent when he needed to know he could trust her, and why they kept their relationship secret for months. Selena tells the story of the day she thought she had a shoot, and the gift that made her say "I can't believe you listened."

Learn why Selena got tired of protecting herself. And learn what Benny does that makes her believe him.

videos.title: Thank You! To everyone who has read or listened to my recently released book Protocols
videos.description:
I’m honored and humbled that Protocols is a #1NYT Best Seller, an Amazon Book Pick for 2026…

… and most of all with the feedback that people are benefiting from the protocols and science it contains.

Protocols covers the science and protocols for improving your sleep, exercise, stress control, nutrition, using light and its effects on hormones, there’s a comprehensive chapter on focus, motivation, and learning/neuroplasticity, and chapter on personal development that covers how to navigate grief, balancing goal pursuit with the rest of life, task switching & more.

Protocols can be read like any other books start to finish or you can go directly to the topics, most of interest to you or the areas of your mental or physical health and performance, you are focused on at a given moment.

I also include story and you’ll learn a lot of science as you learn and implement the protocols.

The book is available in more than a dozen languages. I also read an audiobook version of it. All of those links are available at protocolsbook (You can also find the link here in my YouTube Profile).

Wishing all of you a Happy Thanksgiving and thank you for your interest in science!
